title: Challenging Common Assumptions in the Unsupervised Learning of Disentangled Representations
supported_claims: Under the theorem's factorized continuous-prior assumptions, observational distributions admit entangling reparameterizations.
limitations: Not a general impossibility theorem for all structured sequence models or Voynich.
voynich_implication: State the inductive biases and auxiliary evidence needed to distinguish explanations.

title: Variational Autoencoders and Nonlinear ICA: A Unifying Framework
supported_claims: Auxiliary-variable modulation can identify sufficient statistics up to specified transformations under injectivity, factorial exponential-family and full-rank variability assumptions.
limitations: Ideal-model results; stronger identifiability needs additional assumptions. Metadata alone does not satisfy them.
voynich_implication: Test section/scribe conditioning as a hypothesis and confound, not an automatic identification theorem.

title: A Spectral Algorithm for Learning Hidden Markov Models
supported_claims: Low-order observation moments and SVD estimate observable operators under rank/support conditions; their products predict sequences.
limitations: Sample complexity depends on conditioning and horizon; finite estimates need probability-validity checks.
voynich_implication: Use a spectral comparator with singular-value diagnostics beside probabilistic fitting.

title: Inference in finite state space non parametric Hidden Markov Models and applications
supported_claims: With known state count, full-rank transition and linearly independent emissions, stationary positive-support HMMs are identified up to label permutation by the distribution of three consecutive observations.
limitations: A distribution of triples is not three samples. Ordinary node-emitting assumptions do not directly describe every edge-emitting process.
voynich_implication: Check model class and observable equivalences before scoring latent-state recovery.

title: Computational Mechanics: Pattern and Prediction, Structure and Simplicity
supported_claims: Predictive equivalence classes of pasts provide minimal prescient representations under the paper's process assumptions.
limitations: Whole-future distributions and infinite pasts are idealizations; predictive states need not be the physical generator's variables.
voynich_implication: Target observable predictive equivalence before asserting historical hidden states.

title: Blind Construction of Optimal Nonlinear Recursive Predictors for Discrete Sequences
supported_claims: CSSR constructs predictive history classes and deterministic recursive updates; one-step sufficiency plus recursive closure supports whole-future sufficiency.
limitations: Consistency requires stationarity, finite-state and synchronization conditions; sparse counts and large alphabets matter.
voynich_implication: Compare explicit update closure with next-output clustering. Author names follow the cited version.

title: Predictive Representations of State
supported_claims: Predictions of multi-step tests can represent state, with a finite linear representation constructed from a finite POMDP.
limitations: Existence/construction from a known process is not an unknown-model learning guarantee; our text provides no chosen actions.
voynich_implication: Use joint continuation tests as coordinates and demand consistent updates.

title: Learning Hidden Markov Models Using Conditional Samples
supported_claims: Conditional probability queries and conditional sampling support different learning guarantees; the sample-based result requires a fidelity condition.
limitations: Interactive conditional access is stronger than a static corpus; detailed proofs not fully reviewed.
voynich_implication: Queries to our LM reveal that LM's approximation, not an oracle for the manuscript's author.

title: Learning Hidden Markov Models When the Locations of Missing Observations are Unknown
supported_claims: Unknown observation omissions alter the inferred dynamics and require an explicit observation model.
limitations: Deletion is not filler insertion; unknown retention rates can confound recovery.
voynich_implication: Represent channel assumptions explicitly and test omission-rate misspecification.

title: Bayesian Structural Inference for Hidden Processes
supported_claims: For a fixed unifilar topology and start state, observations determine a unique path, enabling integrated parameter likelihoods and topology comparison.
limitations: The enumerated binary topology family is restricted; posterior confidence is relative to candidate models.
voynich_implication: Keep competing topologies and complexity costs; do not generalize binary enumeration to the full glyph alphabet.

title: Minimum Description Length Revisited
supported_claims: Description-length model selection accounts for both a model and its data encoding; prequential choices and misspecification matter.
limitations: A shorter code under a chosen language is not proof of historical truth; discrete sequential estimates need smoothing.
voynich_implication: Charge for keys, exceptions, null masks and segmentation choices under a frozen coding convention.

title: Transformers Can Do Bayesian Inference
supported_claims: Training over prior-sampled datasets with held-out prediction approximates posterior prediction under that prior.
limitations: Prior misspecification remains; the paper's supervised tasks differ from our proposed visible-only sequence episodes.
voynich_implication: Train on fresh task/key episodes; assess inference under both matched and deliberately wrong priors.

title: DreamCoder: Growing generalizable, interpretable knowledge with wake-sleep Bayesian program learning
supported_claims: Neural-guided program search and library compression alternate with generated training tasks.
limitations: A task specification and program grammar are supplied; this does not supply plaintext supervision. Same work as D22.
voynich_implication: Consider a small typed transducer grammar, with search limits and a cost for every exception.

title: Deep Adaptive Design: Amortizing Sequential Bayesian Experimental Design
supported_claims: A learned policy amortizes sequential design using expected information gain under a prior and likelihood.
limitations: Training cost pays off for repeated design tasks; the historical generating process cannot be queried experimentally.
voynich_implication: First enumerate feasible diagnostics that separate live hypotheses; no learned design policy is needed initially.

title: The frontier of simulation-based inference
supported_claims: Simulation-based inference learns relative to a simulator-defined statistical model; diagnostics do not solve physical misspecification.
limitations: Author review rather than an independent Voynich experiment; only selected discussion inspected.
voynich_implication: Benchmark simulator mismatch and real-data discrepancy independently of inference calibration.

title: Validating Bayesian Inference Algorithms with Simulation-Based Calibration
supported_claims: Prior predictive simulation and posterior rank checks diagnose inference calibration under specified sampling assumptions.
limitations: Correlated posterior samples require care; calibration against a simulator does not validate that simulator historically.
voynich_implication: Use equivalence-aware calibration and assess informativeness and posterior predictions separately.

title: Learning regular sets from queries and counterexamples
supported_claims: Efficient regular-language learning uses membership queries and equivalence queries/counterexamples.
limitations: This is an active teacher-access model, not a guarantee from static positive strings.
voynich_implication: Approximate counterexample search is useful engineering but must not be called an equivalence proof.

title: The reusable holdout: Preserving validity in adaptive data analysis
supported_claims: Adaptive analysis can compromise ordinary holdout reasoning; a formal protected mechanism can support bounded reuse.
limitations: We have not implemented the proposed privacy-based mechanism; this record is abstract-only.
voynich_implication: Use fresh synthetic final pools and preserve the unopened manuscript holdout.
